environment.description: Containerized deployment on EKS with Nitro Enclaves integration. The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) and an emptyDir volume mounted at /opt/app/config_updates with a 50Mi sizeLimit. The container's seccomp profile is set to RuntimeDefault which restricts syscalls. Additionally, the pod security context sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and runs as UID 10001. The HSM access is via AWS CloudHSM PKCS#11 library with IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) scoped to cloudhsm:DescribeClusters only. An AppArmor profile (runtime/default) is applied. The node uses a Bottlerocket AMI with dm-verity on the root partition. The /opt/app/config_updates emptyDir is the ONLY writable path in the container filesystem namespace.
